items.title: He left Chile on foot to England 28 years ago. He's almost finally home
items.dek: British adventurer Karl Bushby has gotten his steps in for a lifetime. He left the southern tip of Chile with a mission: to walk an unbroken path to his hometow
items.body: British adventurer Karl Bushby has gotten his steps in for a lifetime. He left the southern tip of Chile with a mission: to walk an unbroken path to his hometown in England. He had two rules: no use of transportation to advance and no returning home to England until he reached it on foot. submitted by /u/miauguau44 [link] [comments]
